_comment: M11 acceptance script for the INTERACTIVE pageSheet (`openhost --app
showcase`). Window 390x844, sheet top inset 59 -> sheet height 785, so
the measured 50% dismissal threshold sits at 392.5 pt of sheet travel
(402.5 pt of finger travel, since the pan absorbs exactly 10 pt).
0.30-0.90  tap the profile card -> the sheet presents; 0.90 is the
settled state WITH THE GRABBER (36x5 pt, r 2.5, 5 pt below
the sheet's top edge — measured from real iOS 26.1)
1.00-1.50  DRAG DOWN 150 pt and hold still. The finger starts inside
the form's scroll view, which is at the top of its content,
so the drag belongs to the SHEET (measured hand-off). 1.20
and 1.45 are mid-drag: the sheet has moved 140 pt (travel
minus the 10 pt slop) and the dim has faded linearly with
1.55-2.20  released at rest, 17.8% of the way down — under 50%, so it
SPRINGS BACK on the measured critically damped spring
(omega = sqrt(1000/3)). 1.58/1.66 catch it returning, 2.20
is settled again with the dim back at 0.200.
2.60-3.90  DRAG DOWN 450 pt (440 pt of sheet, 56% — past the
threshold) and release at rest: it COMPLETES. 2.95 is the
deep drag (dim nearly gone), 3.30/3.42 are the sheet flying
out on the same spring, 3.90 is the base screen restored.
4.30-6.30  reopen, then scroll the FORM up 130 pt and drag back down.
Once the scroll view has left the top, the same downward
drag belongs to the CONTENT: 6.00 and 6.30 must show the
sheet still at rest with a full-strength dim.
Run: .build/release/openhost --app showcase --scale 2 \
--script scripts/sheet_drag.json --record out_sheet
